timeline.summary: The dryad Mazena confronts Ruzi after class with a message from Guildmaster Trostani.
timeline.quote: We have an important message from Guildmaster Trostani, and you kept us standing for ages,

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

timeline.summary: Mazena orders Ruzi to leave today for the Rubblebelt because Trostani sensed a troubling situation.
timeline.quote: You must go to the Rubblebelt. You must leave today.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

timeline.summary: Cecilee, mute from childhood, suddenly speaks in a beautiful recitation in praise of Selesnya at Vitu-Ghazi, and the dryads call her a conduit to the Worldsoul.
timeline.quote: And then one day Cecilee did speak.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi resolves to break from Selesnya and make destroying Massacre Girl his purpose, knowing Trostani would not permit vengeance.
timeline.quote: If justice was to be done, Ruzi must break from Selesnya and find another way.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Emmara Tandris meets Kaya in the presence of the dormant dryad Trostani, and refuses to commit Selesnya because Ral's plans have been disasters.
timeline.quote: So far, every one has been an unmitigated disaster for the guilds, for Ravnica, and especially for Selesnya.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Mistress Cim awakes and persuades Mistress Ses to restore Trostani's harmony, and Selesnya joins the other guilds against Bolas.
timeline.quote: It is the will of Mat'Selesnya that the Conclave join the other guilds to defeat Nicol Bolas.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Kellan explains that Vitu-Ghazi was moved to the moor to recover after the invasion.
timeline.quote: Mat'Selesnya told Trostani that Vitu-Ghazi needed space to put down new root structures

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 5: Chains of Expectation
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 5: Chains of Expectation" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Trostani appears as three dryads from the oak and agrees to let Kaya consult the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Three dryads, each one an individual, and collectively the singular entity through which the Worldsoul of Ravnica was said to speak.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 5: Chains of Expectation
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 5: Chains of Expectation" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: The guild leaders consent to the interviews, with Kaya consenting for the Orzhov and Izoni for the Golgari.
timeline.quote: The Golgari approve.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft explains that Vitu-Ghazi's roots could deliver the flowers anywhere in the city.
timeline.quote: The roots of Vitu-Ghazi spread throughout the city.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Trostani's three faces show conflicting reactions.
timeline.quote: She said nothing, only continued looking back, the expressions on her three faces completely out of alignment.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft dismisses Tolsimir's confession, noting he lacked the ability to create the plant.
timeline.quote: Noble of you to try to take the burden of blame onto yourself, but you didn't do this

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft names Trostani as the mastermind behind all the killings.
timeline.quote: Trostani did this, all of it. She's been behind it all along.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: The room is stunned by Proft's accusation that Trostani is the killer and Ezrim asks Kaya if she knew.
timeline.quote: Ezrim looked to Kaya.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Tolsimir insists Trostani cannot have done it because she cannot leave the healing tree.
timeline.quote: she can't leave Vitu-Ghazi while the tree is healing!

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Oba separates from her sisters, ending Trostani as a unified being.
timeline.quote: Farther and farther from them she pulled herself, until she was, while still attached to the tree itself, an entirely independent entity, Trostani no longer.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Cim says the Guildpact has no way to sever Oba, who remains their sister, and that a rotten branch must be removed.
timeline.quote: Oba remains one-third of us; we have no way to sever her.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Cim says Trostani will go into communion with Mat'Selesnya to learn whether she wants them to remain, and Emmara Tandris will speak for the Conclave.
timeline.quote: Emmara Tandris will speak for the Conclave while we are in communion

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft asks how Niv-Mizzet could fail to notice Trostani's use of Ravnica to kill, and the dragon says he was otherwise occupied.
timeline.quote: "I was otherwise occupied," said Niv-Mizzet, somewhat stiffly.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft deduces the killer is in the Selesnya Conclave and exposes Trostani; Tolsimir's false confession is rebuffed.
timeline.quote: However, Proft rebuffed him, asserting that he was trying to take the fall for the true killer: Trostani, guildmaster of the Selesnya Conclave.

citation.text: "Alquist Proft", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oba attacks; Etrata helps trap her in an Agency barrier ward and is neutralized by Oba's sisters.
timeline.quote: she ultimately helped trap Oba in an Agency barrier ward.

citation.text: "Alquist Proft", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Selesnya agrees to help after Trostani awakens and overrules Emmara Tandris.
timeline.quote: her decision was overruled when Trostani awakened and ruled in favor of helping the Gatewatch

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Trostani commands Emmara to investigate the Izzet and gives her command of the conclave's elementals; she forgives Jace, but House Dimir has followed her.
timeline.quote: House Dimir had already followed Emmara, and she had led them right to Jace.

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Calomir overrides Emmara's fears and Trostani calls for war; Emmara agrees to summon the greater elementals.
timeline.quote: she agreed to summon the greater elementals of the Selesnyan Conclave

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Selesnya march on the Rakdos and into the Boros Legion; Niv-Mizzet reveals the maze's secrets, Emmara is arrested for treason and learns from Jace that Lazav replaced Calomir.
timeline.quote: she learned that Lazav had taken Calomir's place months ago

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Rakdos guildgate Emmara withstands Exava's demons until Trostani arrives with reinforcements.
timeline.quote: Trostani arrived with reinforcements, apologetic for the trials Emmara had suffered

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As Trostani is divided and Garo is revealed as Bolas's ally, Emmara steps forward to lead the Conclave and pursue guild peace.
timeline.quote: Emmara stepped forward to fill the void in leadership

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "Ravnica Allegiance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emmara first declines Kaya's plan to revive Niv-Mizzet, but Harmony wakes and the Selesnya join the fight against Bolas.
timeline.quote: Harmony, the middle Trostani, finally woke up and decided that Selesnya would be joining the other guilds to defeat Bolas.

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emmara represents the Selesnya at Niv-Mizzet's resurrection; three years later she regains control of the guild when Trostani is implicated in the Karlov Manor murders.
timeline.quote: Tandris regained control of the guild

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Vitu-Ghazi, the detective reveals that Oba organized the murders as retribution against traitors of the plane, and that Etrata was Zegana's killer.
timeline.quote: the detective revealed that Oba, the central dryad of Trostani

citation.text: "Etrata", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Proft reveals Oba as the killer; Oba attacks and Kellan is flung from the ceiling and discovers he can fly, before Trostani is subdued by Kaya and Etrata.
timeline.quote: After Trostani was subdued by Kaya and Etrata, Kellan returned to his desk at the Agency.

citation.text: "Kellan", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teysa is murdered, later revealed as Trostani's work, and returns as a ghost to organize a new ghost council.
timeline.quote: Teysa was a victim of the murders, later revealed to have been orchestrated by Trostani , but returned as a ghost days later to organize a new ghost council and continue her leadership of the guild.

citation.text: "Orzhov Syndicate", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Proft solves the case, revealing Trostani as the mastermind behind the murders.
timeline.quote: Before open war could be declared, Proft was able to solve the case.

citation.text: "Ravnica", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Implicit Maze, a battle erupts in Rix Maadi between Rakdos and Selesnya, wounding Exava and Emmara.
timeline.quote: a battle broke out between the local Rakdos and Selesnya representatives

citation.text: "Rix Maadi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Decamillennial the Selesnya lose their connection to the World Tree and rely on a high council; Mat'Selesnya goes dormant within Vitu-Ghazi and Suniel helps three dryads fuse into Trostani.
timeline.quote: Suniel helped three Dryad sisters to fuse into Trostani to function as the direct voice of Mat'Selesnya and as the new guildmaster.

citation.text: "Selesnya Conclave", section "Leadership". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Before the War of the Spark Trostani's three heads fall into discord, and Emmara steps forward after Garo is revealed to be in league with Bolas.
timeline.quote: Emmara Tandris stepped forward to fill the void in leadership, after glade-master Garo was revealed to be in league with Nicol Bolas .

citation.text: "Selesnya Conclave", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya, Teyo and Rat ask Selesnya's help to revive Niv-Mizzet; Emmara declines but Harmony wakes and commits Selesnya to the alliance against Bolas.
timeline.quote: Harmony, the middle Trostani, finally woke up and decided that Selesnya would be joining the other guilds to defeat Bolas.

citation.text: "Selesnya Conclave", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oba becomes the primary aspect of Trostani and lends strength to Vitu-Ghazi after its damage in the War of the Spark and the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Oba, the dryad of life, became the primary aspect of Trostani, lending her strength to the tree

citation.text: "Selesnya Conclave", section "Phyrexian invasion and aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Trostani commits a series of murders of prominent Ravnicans with mind-controlling spores; Oba is subdued by her sisters and control returns to Emmara.
timeline.quote: After Oba was subdued by her sisters, Trostani stepped back to confer with Mat'Selesnya, returning control of the guild to Emmara Tandris.

citation.text: "Selesnya Conclave", section "Phyrexian invasion and aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The three dryads materialize in Vitu-Ghazi as Trostani, the new guildmaster, and Suniel realizes Cim is gone.
timeline.quote: The three who are one told the high priests that they were now Trostani

citation.text: "Suniel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The three dryad sisters enter a trance to reconnect with Mat'Selesnya; Suniel binds them to an old oak and the Parun fuses them with the World Tree, creating Trostani.
timeline.quote: this old Parun fused the three dryads with the World Tree, creating Trostani.

citation.text: "Trostani", section "Creation of Trostani". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Before the War of the Spark the three heads of Trostani are in discord, leaving her paralyzed; Emmara Tandris fills the leadership void.
timeline.quote: During the War, Emmara Tandris stepped forward to fill the void in leadership.

citation.text: "Trostani", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya's party convinces Trostani to join the fight against Bolas and she becomes concordant again.
timeline.quote: was convinced by Kaya 's party to join the fight against Bolas and became concordant again.

citation.text: "Trostani", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vitu-Ghazi is replanted in a Selesnya park and the dryads change positions, with Oba at the center.
timeline.quote: Vitu-Ghazi was replanted in a Selesnya park, and Trostani moved along with it.

citation.text: "Trostani", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vitu-Ghazi is replanted in a moor within a park on Selesnya territory around a manor-library.
timeline.quote: The tree was planted around a manor

citation.text: "Vitu-Ghazi", section "Replanting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
